_readme: Project-level MCP servers. Copy this file to .cursor/mcp.json to activate.
Cursor merges project (.cursor/mcp.json) and user (~/.cursor/mcp.json) servers.
Two transport styles: remote { url } (usually with OAuth in Cursor) or local
{ command, args, env } that Cursor spawns. Reference secrets via ${env:VAR};
never hardcode tokens. Remove servers you don't use. See README 'MCP servers'.
The _readme and _comment keys are ignored by Cursor.

atlassian._comment: Jira + Confluence via Atlassian's official Rovo MCP (remote, OAuth in Cursor). Adjust the URL to the current Atlassian MCP endpoint.

stitch._comment: Stitch (design). Replace the package/URL with the real Stitch MCP server; supply keys via env, not literals.

filesystem-example._comment: Example of a local stdio server. Safe to delete.
